answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 21743 Country: India Title: my question is (can we use hairdye to dye our hair?) Question: asslawalekum janab my question is (can we use hairdye to dye our hair?) Answer ID: 21743 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 633/633/M=1431) You can colour hair, but it is forbidden to dye with black colour. و يكره بالسواد (درمختار) The hair dye of red henna is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
